explanation: Dosing, food, swallowing-whole, and missed-dose instructions match evidence, but the text omits that IBRANCE is always given in combination with an aromatase inhibitor, fulvestrant, or inavolisib/fulvestrant, and omits the 'do not take if broken/cracked' caveat.
suggested_rewrite: Mrs. J is started on the standard regimen (125 mg once daily, 21 days on/7 days off, 28-day cycle) in combination with her prescribed endocrine therapy. Capsules require food; tablets may be taken with or without food. Swallow whole—never chew, crush, split, or take if broken/cracked. Skip a missed or vomited dose that day.
